evidence: base_census_check.out (complete census and census with capped words; the capped one reproduces S10 digit for digit); replicate_every_base_count.out (the session's six counts reproduced exactly by a replica with the cap and the 'continue'; complete counts 57,818,155 / 35,564,915 / 24,947,862 / 18,838,778 / 14,919,260 / 7,634,213). fix: In s10() build psi for h <= 2 X/(3 beta) + 4; in census_b pass the full q and delete the 'continue' branch (keep the 'break'); rerun both and replace the outputs. In THM-5134: "remainder at most 0.17 (0.167 at b = 2, p = 7)".
